title: EngineErrorBody
description: Every non-2xx reply the engine sends: `{"error": {"code", "message", "type"}}` (`format_error_response`, server-common.cpp). The core decides on `type` and the HTTP code, never on `message`, which is for the reader.

ErrorType.description: The engine's error classes. One it does not know is `Unknown`, never guessed into a known one.

oneOf.description: 400: the request was refused before anything ran (a documented refusal)
501: the server was started without the capability (no `--train-dir`)
